title: Setting financial goals
log: 2026-11-12T12:44:14Z match: Claude Haiku 5.5 found no bank point the same, so it is written new
2026-11-12T16:19:51Z autoreview: cleared with the fix (card wording)

match.reason: The closest bank point, on short and long-term goals, covers only two time horizons and does not teach medium-term goals or the idea that a goal with a set amount and date is easier to reach, so the new point is broader than any bank match.

draft.title: Setting financial goals
card: A financial goal is something you want to pay for with your money. Goals are grouped by how long they take to reach.
Short term
a goal you can reach soon, such as new shoes or a movie ticket.
Medium term
a goal that takes longer, such as a laptop.
Long term
a goal that takes many years, such as a car or a home. Clear goals are easier to reach when they state an amount and a date.
draft.remember: Goals are short, medium or long term. An amount and a date make a goal clear.

a.q: Which of these is the clearest financial goal?
opts: Save $600 for a laptop by the end of June
Save some money for a laptop soon
Try to buy a laptop one day
Spend less so a laptop is possible
a.why: This goal states both an amount, $600, and a date, the end of June. The others are vague, so it is hard to tell if they have been reached.
a.clue: Look for the goal with a number and a deadline.

b.q: Priya is 13. She wants a $40 bucket hat next month, a $900 bike in two years and a home when she is an adult. Which pair is matched correctly?
opts: Hat is short term, home is long term
Hat is medium term, bike is short term
Bike is long term, home is medium term
Hat is long term, bike is medium term
b.why: The hat is bought next month, so it is short term. A home takes many years, so it is long term. The bike is tempting to call long term, but two years is closer to medium term.
b.clue: Sort each goal by how long it takes to reach.

a.best: Save $600 for a laptop by the end of June

b.best: Hat is short term, home is long term

problems.detail: The sentence 'Clear goals are easier to reach when they state an amount and a date' sits inside the long-term bullet, so students may think it applies only to long-term goals. It belongs in its own line, since question a applies it to a laptop (medium-term) goal.

check.summary: Both answers are correct and well supported. The one problem is that the line about clear goals needing an amount and a date is tucked into the long-term bullet, where it reads as if it applies only to long-term goals.

proposal.title: Setting financial goals
card: Short term
a financial goal (something you save money for) that you can reach within a few months, such as new shoes or a movie ticket.
Medium term
a goal that takes about one to a few years to reach, such as a laptop.
Long term
a goal that takes many years to reach, such as a car or a home.
Any goal, short, medium or long term, is easier to reach when it is clear. A clear goal states an amount and a date.
proposal.remember: Sort a goal by how long it takes. Give every goal an amount and a date.

a.q: Which of these is the clearest financial goal?
opts: Save $600 for a laptop by the end of June
Save some money for a laptop very soon
Try to buy a good laptop one day
Spend less each week so a laptop is possible
a.why: This goal states both an amount, $600, and a date, the end of June. The others are vague, so it is hard to plan for them or to tell when they have been reached.
a.clue: Look for the goal with a number and a deadline.

b.q: Priya is 13. She wants a $40 bucket hat next month, a $900 bike in two years and a home when she is an adult. Which pair is matched correctly?
opts: Hat is short term, home is long term
Hat is medium term, bike is short term
Bike is long term, home is medium term
Hat is long term, bike is medium term
b.why: The hat is bought next month, so it is short term. A home takes many years, so it is long term. The bike is tempting to call long term because it costs a lot, but two years fits medium term.
b.clue: Sort each goal by how long it takes to reach, not by its price.
